tips.title: Create a holder or extension for a milling tool or drilling tool
tips.body: Import a 3D geometry file in *.step,*.stp, *.iges or *.hmc format using the TOOL Builder.

tips.title: Define the geometry of the holder
tips.body: Select geometric entities and define the body by highlighting them in color.

tips.title: Define the axis of the holder
tips.body: Manually adjust the direction of the axis by selecting entities or points, and invert the direction if necessary.

tips.title: Define the coupling area for the holder
tips.body: Select a Face or Point to define the upper and lower coupling areas, ensuring they are perpendicular to the Z axis.

tips.title: Create a rotational profile for the holder
tips.body: The program creates a rotational profile based on the defined body geometry and axis alignment.

tips.title: Export the rotational shape to hyperMILL
tips.body: Export the generated rotational shape to transfer it to the tool definition in hyperMILL.

tips.title: Create a Back boring tool with the TOOL Builder
tips.body: Select Body and insert or Mono-bloc for the geometry type, open a 3D geometry file in *.step,*.stp or *.hmc format.

tips.title: Define the body geometry for a Back boring tool
tips.body: The geometry of the tool is automatically detected after opening the file.

tips.title: Define the axis for a Back boring tool
tips.body: Select elements or points to define the direction of the axis, and invert it if necessary.

tips.title: Define the coupling for a Back boring tool
tips.body: Select a Face or Point to define the area of the tool coupling.

tips.title: Export data for a Back boring tool
tips.body: Transfer the imported 3D file with previously defined elements to the tool database as a back boring tool.

tips.title: Create a static holder for machining with a turret
tips.body: Import a 3D geometry file in *.step,*.stp, *.iges or *.hmc format using the TOOL Builder.

tips.title: Define the body geometry for a static holder
tips.body: The geometry of the holder is automatically detected after opening the file.

tips.title: Define the holder axis
tips.body: Select required elements or points to define the direction of the axis, and invert it if necessary.

tips.title: Define the holder coupling
tips.body: Select a Face or Point to define the area of the tool coupling.

tips.title: Export data for a static holder
tips.body: Transfer the imported 3D file with previously defined elements to the tool database as a static holder.

tips.title: Define colors for display and precision options
tips.body: Specify colors for Axis, Machine / workpiece indicators, Profile, Body mesh, Insert mesh, and Rotational shape.

tips.title: Set mesh tolerance for reading geometry data
tips.body: Specify the precision for reading in the geometry data in *.step,*.stp, *.iges or *.hmc formats.

tips.title: Set profile tolerance for tool holder and holder profiles
tips.body: Specify the precision for the outline profile of the insert tool holder and rotational profile of the holder.

tips.title: Display background color in Assembly mode
tips.body: Select the Assembly - bottom color and Assembly - top color options to display the background of the graphics area.
